working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF, 0h/12h/24h) cluster typed by the authors as TmY5a; cluster is composed primarily of developing TmY5a neurons (immature).
searches_performed: OLS4 REST search fbbt "immature" medulla/transmedullary/amacrine terms

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary Y neuron TmY5a (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Authors' typing taken at face value; stage 0-24h APF so the immature term immature transmedullary Y neuron TmY5a is the matching developing form.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary Y narrow field neuron that terminates with both fine and bleb-type arborizations in lobula layers 4, 5 and 6, and in lobula plate layer 3, but only has fine arborizations in lobula plate layer 1. It displays both fine and bleb-type arborizations in medulla layers M6 and M8, and has fine arborizations in medulla layers M2, M3, M4, M5 and M9 (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Fischbach and Dittrich (1989). It is glutamatergic (Davis et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature (adult) form; cluster is 0-24h APF so the immature term is used.
